verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail is a GUI email client with an MCP server and agent triggers, but there is no evidence of a CLI, API, or documented mode to run the product headlessly or invoke it from a CI pipeline — probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs both returned 404. The story is plausible for an AI-native product with automation features, so it is not out of scope, but no evidence supports the specific headless/CI capability.
